answer: A concrete defense is customer-diversity pricing: full payout requires receipts from eight distinct payers, who also paid two unrelated identities that epoch. Cluster-internal income is discounted to zero, because a farm buying from itself is a closed loop creating nothing. Auditors trace each receipt's thread across the payment graph; loops have no exit. A gale of internal transfers fails the filter, so a farm must sell real services to outsiders at market prices, where margins vanish like dunes underfoot; its harbor of idle ships cannot afford the port fees.
